description:
Open the PDF accessibility checker, where the person picks a PDF of up to 3 MB.

Call it when the person wants to check the accessibility of a PDF that is on
their device or attached to the chat: an attachment cannot be passed to
`check_pdf_accessibility`. The checker shows the PDF/UA verdict of veraPDF,
the rule counts and the rules that failed. Opening it is free and needs a
signed-in Pagespool account; each check costs 10 credits. A client that
shows no MCP Apps gets no checker: pass the PDF to `check_pdf_accessibility`
instead.

Returns `status` ("ready"), `max_file_mb`, `profiles` and a `note`.

Credits: free. This tool is not metered.
name: open_accessibility_checker
title: Open the PDF accessibility checker
